description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge dies, triggering Hofri, exiling Eternal Scourge and creating a token copy of it that's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
The Eternal Scourge token dies, returning nothing to your graveyard due to Eternal Scourge no longer being in exile.
Repeat.
